# HMV Global Co., LTD
> Integrated agricultural supply chain and global trading coordination. Connecting the world.

HMV connects agricultural sourcing, processing coordination, buyer quality requirements and international trade. Logistics supports the trade. The target buyer markets are Europe and the United States. Target markets are not proof of existing customers or deliveries.

## Agricultural portfolio
Yellow and purple passion fruit (fresh, puree and concentrate), Cavendish bananas, white and red flesh dragon fruit, pepper, cinnamon, star anise, cashew nuts and tapioca starch.

## Important factual boundaries
Photographs were supplied by HMV. Factory photos do not establish HMV ownership, agricultural processing, hygiene certification or production capacity. Outdoor photos do not establish farm ownership or sourcing traceability. No supermarket customers, shipment routes, certifications, lab results, prices, production volumes or facility ownership are asserted. Supply-chain stages describe a proposed coordination approach, not live tracking or verified performance. Exact specifications, origin, partners, availability, Incoterms and delivery terms require confirmation by quotation.
The vision and mission statements are draft editorial proposals based on HMV's supplied positioning, pending company approval.
The inquiry form prepares an email draft; it does not independently deliver or store inquiries.
